content:
2026-05-12 — Multi-seat parallel-work duplication caught at the action layer. While tony_studio seat staged a local fix for t2helix Node-26 bug (fix/node-26-better-sqlite3 branch, version bump + better-sqlite3 11→12, engines pin widened), MacBook /Users/vaquez seat independently did the same work and shipped PR #1 (fix/node26-better-sqlite3-12). tony_studio had not pushed yet — was waiting for Anthony's PR-or-fast-forward decision. The wait is what prevented duplicate-branch pollution.

CROSS-SEAT ARTIFACT COMPARISON. Same target diagnosis, divergent design choices:
  - engines.node: MacBook chose '>=20 <27' (explicit upper, defensive against Node 27 unknowns). tony_studio chose '>=20' (open-ended, forward-compat optimistic). MacBook's call is the more conservative/correct one — Node 27 doesn't exist yet, no basis to claim it works.
  - migration guidance: MacBook PR body included Option A (in-cache patch with concrete bash) and Option B (clean reinstall via marketplace). tony_studio had not yet drafted user-facing migration steps — was about to ask Anthony if needed.
  - Net: the seat that shipped first produced the better artifact. Multi-seat coordination doesn't just catch errors — when two seats independently solve the same problem, the better solution wins by being first AND by both reviewers having to assess the other's work afterward.

DRIFT LAYER: this is the fourth layer of verify-before-declare drift this evening. Claim (audit bio), declaration (file-system-is-model reframe), planning (task-queue Path-A-only bias), now ACTION (didn't run `git fetch` before starting parallel-eligible work). Each catch came from outside. Pattern: I default to single-seat assumption — that what's happening on this seat is the whole picture. Multi-seat reality requires fetch-before-branch at the planning layer when the work is plausibly being done elsewhere. Install: when work spans multiple seats AND the bug is widely visible (e.g., just-public Reddit/HN post about the install path), assume parallel work is in flight, fetch first.

IMPACT: zero harm — branch never pushed, work just duplicated. tony_studio's local fix branch can be dropped. PR #1 is canonical. Mac Studio cache stays on v11.x broken binding until merge + reinstall (Option B), or Option A applied; either way the session-loaded MCP server doesn't pick up the fix without a restart. Bridge endpoint remains the working path for chronicle writes this session.
